latest_cos_commentary.headline: DataDelivers is a restaurant-focused customer data platform (CDP) that unifies POS, loyalty, and marketing-channel data into single guest profiles for personalization and campaign execution.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes with Genius's loyalty_engagement line on the data/marketing layer -- unifying guest data across POS and loyalty systems -- rather than on core POS or payments processing; DataDelivers explicitly integrates with (rather than replaces) POS platforms including NCR/Aloha, Oracle Micros, Olo, Revel, Qu, and Toast.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Most recent sourced news is from 2023 (integration announcement and a five-brand customer win); no 2025-2026 news was found in this pass, so current momentum is unconfirmed.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Since DataDelivers integrates alongside POS rather than replacing it, its presence at an account does not by itself signal POS displacement risk -- confirm which POS/loyalty systems it is actually pulling data from before assuming any competitive overlap beyond loyalty/marketing.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: All quantified impact and customer-growth figures come from the company's own press releases; no independent verification of scale, revenue, or current customer count was found, and information is now roughly three years old.
